)

       s."QT_POPULACAO" AS total_habitantes

JOIN municipios mu ON s."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D"

ORDER BY s."QT_POPULACAO" DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM (

           c."DESCRICAO",
           COUNT(*) AS total,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mu."SG_UF" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn

    JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D"

) sub
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY estado, rn;

queries.question: Quais são os 3 hospitais com maior custo médio de UTI por estado (MA e RS)?

FROM (
    SELECT mu."SG_UF" AS estado,

           AVG(i."VAL_UTI") AS custo_medio_uti,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mu."SG_UF" ORDER BY AVG(i."VAL_UTI") DESC) AS rn

    JOIN municipios mu ON h."MUNIC_MOV" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D"
    WHERE i."VAL_UTI" > 0 AND mu."SG_UF" IN ('MA', 'RS')
    GROUP BY mu."SG_UF", h."CNES"
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
) sub
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY estado, rn;

queries.question: Quais são os 10 municípios do RS com taxa de mortalidade acima da média estadual (considerando apenas municípios com mais de 500 internações)?
queries.gold_sql:
WITH media_rs AS (
    SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS taxa_media
    FROM internacoes i
    JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D"
    WHERE mu."SG_UF" = 'RS'
), por_municipio AS (
    SELECT mu."NO_MUNICIPIO" AS nome,
           COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes,
           ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade
    FROM internacoes i
    JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D"
    WHERE mu."SG_UF" = 'RS'
    GROUP BY mu."NO_MUNICIPIO"
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 500
)
SELECT pm.nome, pm.total_internacoes, pm.taxa_mortalidade
FROM por_municipio pm, media_rs mr
WHERE pm.taxa_mortalidade > mr.taxa_media
ORDER BY pm.taxa_mortalidade DESC
LIMIT 10;

queries.question: Quais os 3 hospitais com maior valor médio de serviço hospitalar (VAL_SH) por estado (MA e RS), considerando hospitais com mais de 500 internações?
queries.gold_sql:
SELECT estado, "CNES", avg_val_sh
FROM (
    SELECT mu."SG_UF" AS estado,
           i."CNES",
           ROUND(AVG(i."VAL_SH"), 2) AS avg_val_sh,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mu."SG_UF" ORDER BY AVG(i."VAL_SH") DESC) AS rn
    FROM internacoes i
    JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES"
    JOIN municipios mu ON h."MUNIC_MOV" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D"
    WHERE mu."SG_UF" IN ('MA', 'RS') AND i."VAL_SH" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mu."SG_UF", i."CNES"
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 500
) sub
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY estado, avg_val_sh DESC;

queries.question: Qual o custo medio por dia calendario de internacao por especialidade e desfecho de morte?
queries.gold_sql:
SELECT e."DESCRICAO" AS especialidade,
       CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 'obito' ELSE 'sem_obito' END AS desfecho,
       COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes,
       ROUND(AVG(i."VAL_TOT" / NULLIF(date_diff('day', i."DT_INTER", i."DT_SAIDA") + 1, 0)), 2) AS custo_medio_por_dia_calendario
FROM internacoes i
JOIN especialidade e ON i."ESPEC" = e."ESPEC"
WHERE i."VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL
  AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL
  AND i."DT_SAIDA" IS NOT NULL
  AND date_diff('day', i."DT_INTER", i."DT_SAIDA") >= 0
GROUP BY e."DESCRICAO", desfecho
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000
ORDER BY custo_medio_por_dia_calendario DESC
LIMIT 20;

queries.question: Quais capitulos CID concentram mais internacoes de alto custo acima do percentil 99 do valor total?
queries.gold_sql: WITH limite AS (SELECT QUANTILE_CONT("VAL_TOT", 0.99) AS p99_valor FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL), alto_custo AS (SELECT i."DIAG_PRINC", i."VAL_TOT" FROM internacoes i, limite l WHERE i."VAL_TOT" > l.p99_valor) SELECT c."DS_CAPITULO" AS capitulo_cid, COUNT(*) AS internacoes_alto_custo, ROUND(SUM(a."VAL_TOT"), 2) AS custo_total_alto_custo FROM alto_custo a JOIN cid c ON a."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" GROUP BY c."DS_CAPITULO" ORDER BY internacoes_alto_custo DESC LIMIT 10;
queries.generated_sql: WITH internacoes_custos AS ( SELECT SUBSTR(i."DIAG_PRINC", 1, 1) AS cid_capitulo, SUM(i."VAL_TOT") AS valor_total_internacoes FROM internacoes i GROUP BY cid_capitulo ), percentil_99 AS ( SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY valor_total_internacoes) AS valor_99 FROM internacoes_custos ) SELECT ic.cid_capitulo, ic.valor_total_internacoes FROM internacoes_custos ic JOIN percentil_99 p ON ic.valor_total_internacoes > p.valor_99 ORDER BY ic.valor_total_internacoes DESC;
